subject.title: [Bug] Telegram inbound images download but are not passed to model as vision input

question: Should current-turn image resolution forward successfully loaded native images when some same-turn image attachments fail, or keep the current all-or-nothing prompt-ref fallback?
rationale: Current main covers single-image native hydration but has an explicit partial-media fallback expectation; changing that behavior affects shared channel message delivery and needs maintainer intent before the issue can close.

options.title: Repair aligned partial delivery
options.body: Preserve source positions through the prompt-image boundary, add missing-first and missing-middle coverage, and require real Telegram or equivalent proof before closing this issue.

options.title: Keep fallback behavior
options.body: Treat partial native forwarding as out of scope, close or narrow the linked PR, and close this issue only if maintainers accept current single-image hydration as sufficient.

options.title: Defer for live proof
options.body: Leave this issue and linked PR open until a maintainer or Mantis run verifies the reported Telegram workflow and the partial-failure scenario.

recommendation.title: Repair aligned partial delivery
recommendation.body: Preserve source positions through the prompt-image boundary, add missing-first and missing-middle coverage, and require real Telegram or equivalent proof before closing this issue.

likelyOwner.reason: They most recently owned the mixed image ordering contract in the affected resolver boundary.
